newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady in quiet market.

text.p: European low sulphur straight-run was quiet by mid-week with buyers and sellers still far apart, while high sulphur Russian was offered at higher numbers.
Sellers of 0.5-0.7 percent sulphur material were heard to be in the three figures while one bid was heard at $97 fob a tonne for second half July cargo.
"I don't see them (sellers) achieving three figures at the moment with crude down," one buyer said.
"For sellers, it seems the market is tied to crude when it is going up but not the other way around," he said.
Some U.S. buying interest was seen on the market.
Traders said a number of Russian M-100 straight run were on offer at higher prices, two means plus $2.50/$3 or more.
